summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release announcing CEO David Stamler's presentation at the Canaccord Genuity Drug and Device Conference on October 12, 2026, at 3:50 p.m. AEST, including roundtable investor discussions. No transactional terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics appear. This is a routine foreign private issuer current report (US equivalent of a Form 8-K investor-event disclosure) concerning a conference appearance, not a special situation. What to watch: any ensuing capital raise, partnership, or strategic update to support the planned Phase 3 MSA trial.
